python3 - <<'PY'
# Annual convertible foreign currencies, CY 1963-1977 (in millions of dollars)
data = [212, 432, 781, 1321, 2345, 3528, 2781, 629, 276, 241, 8, 5, 80, 320, 18]

years = list(range(1963, 1978))
print("Years:", years)
print("Values:", data)
print("n =", len(data))

import statistics

mean = statistics.mean(data)
print("Mean:", mean)

stdev = statistics.stdev(data)  # sample stdev (n-1 denominator)
print("Sample stdev:", stdev)

# Fisher-Pearson sample skewness
# g1 = n/((n-1)*(n-2)) * sum(((x - mean)/s)^3)
n = len(data)
s = stdev
skew_sum = sum(((x - mean) / s) ** 3 for x in data)
g1 = (n / ((n - 1) * (n - 2))) * skew_sum
print("Fisher-Pearson skewness (raw):", g1)
print("Rounded to nearest thousandths:", round(g1, 3))
PY

$$g_1 = \frac{n}{(n-1)(n-2)} \sum_{i=1}^{n} \left(\frac{x_i - \bar{x}}{s}\right)^3$$
